interpretation_limits: Thirteen selected development cases and a same-family LLM judge do not establish general accuracy, judge reliability or superiority over a general assistant.
Identical pass/fail totals on two different source versions do not establish equivalence or a causal improvement. Model nondeterminism and changed source remain relevant.

The final source uses Opus for bounded recovery as well as the separately prompted offline judge. Frozen references and assertions remain evaluation-only; separate requests do not eliminate shared-model error correlation.
Reported cost includes returned agent and offline judge usage, excludes online Signals and unreturned provider charges, and is not an account invoice.
